_doc: Measured state of the ecosystem. Every session reads this before asserting anything about the ecosystem. Generated, never hand written, regenerated by the self-heal loop and by CI. A stale copy fails the build rather than misleading a reader.
_how_to_use: This file answers 'what is true now'. ops/PATH_REGISTRY.json answers 'where is everything'. CLAUDE.md answers 'what are the rules'. Read all three at session start, in that order, before running anything.
hard_constraints: No agent runs ANY git command from the zero-trust analysis mount, read-only included. status, add and diff each take .git/index.lock and abandon it, manufacturing the blocker the agent then reports. L-122, L-123, L-150.
The authenticated push is the operator's, because the GitHub credential is his and no agent may hold it. G-03, G-04.
Promotion and an Article 14 signature are the operator's. G-06 limit 2. Everything else an agent may do, it does. SH-10d.
Lesson ids come from verify_ledger_singleton.py plus the pending reservations, never from the tail of the ledger. L-151.
The lander is LAND_EVERYTHING_FINAL.bat in the sovereign-infra root. It is one double-click and it is idempotent.
